Bxs (section 9.6's Set<object> and Distinct over boxed values, and Set<object> holding comparers), Nc (x?.Comparer and ?. after a ?. chain), Ifs (a string held in an interface slot: its Equals, GetHashCode and default equality while authored equality classes exist), Cl, Clg and Cls (section 9.7's closure placement: == on lambdas built per loop iteration, per call and per receiver, generic and interface hosts, and closures stored in fields and lists), Var (section 9.7's variance-converted delegates keep the type they were created as: Equals, ==, GetType, is, casts and List.Contains), Gm (section 5.4's generic method groups: inferred and written type arguments, equality and hashing), Ib (statics in interface slots holding a box or a comparer, read and reassigned), Sc (section 12.1's stored EqualityComparer<T>.Create and Comparer<T>.Create comparers from lambdas and method groups, in static slots, Sets, Dictionaries, lists and object slots, and returned through an interface), Pg (section 8.3's primitive member statics as method groups: Parse, Add, Compare and Equals, their overloads by delegate type, equality and errors), Dd (section 9.7's cached lambdas: field initializers and lambdas that capture nothing share one delegate per closed declaring type and generic method, across instances). Mgc (section 9.7's cached static method groups: one delegate per containing type and construction, per delegate type, or per generic method and its type arguments when the group names them; built-in and T.M groups too), Ig (method groups in field initializers: generic, built-in, a generic class's statics and T.M; a static initializer's group isn't the cached one). Groups with their own helpers live in Probe<Group> classes.
